item.title: Mum Tries to FRAME Her 2-Year-Old Son!
item.description: After 5-year-old Destiny Oliver was fatally shot inside her Tennessee home, her mother, Robin Howington, gave investigators multiple versions of what happened. She ultimately blamed her 2-year-old son, while evidence showed she had wiped down the gun and hidden it outside. What really happened that night?

item.title: A Hotel Had Already Put the Family on Its “Do Not Rent” List
item.description: Five-year-old Xaquie Bynum died from carbon monoxide poisoning inside her New Mexico home. A lawsuit now claims child welfare officials had received repeated reports about the family and had even warned them about unsafe heating methods. Could her death have been prevented?
